sehemu: Part I: Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and President of Zanzibar
jina: Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and its jurisdiction
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Government of Zanzibar to be known as the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar which shall have authority in Zanzibar over all matters which are not Union Matters in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution. (2) Subject to the provisions of this Article and the following Articles in this Chapter, the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall be constituted and shall exercise its powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Government of Zanzibar to be known as the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar which shall have authority in Zanzibar over all matters which are not Union Matters in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution.

(2) Subject to the provisions of this Article and the following Articles in this Chapter, the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall be constituted and shall exercise its powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984.
